blocks.content: Course: API Handling with Asynchronous Javascript
Hi, I'm Aatish 👋 and I've been a professional developer with over six years of experience working with JavaScript.
Like many developers, I didn't struggle with async JavaScript because of syntax.
I struggled because the async and runtime concepts didn't make sense at first.
That confusion is exactly why this course is structured the way it is. The way I wish async had been taught to me, with:

items: Honest explanations about what is confusing and why

blocks.content: Throughout the course, I'll occasionally point out:

items: Mistakes developers often make early on
Better ways to think about async behavior

blocks.content: The goal is not perfection, but clarity and confidence.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
